changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la vista v_path_step_metrics (solo lectura): por ruta, tema y brazo del piloto, pasos aprobados, aprobados al primer intento, intentos promedio y abandonos por tema (D3).
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW v_path_step_metrics AS SELECT lp.id AS learning_path_id, ps.topic_id, e.pilot_arm, count(*) AS steps_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.status = 'passed') AS steps_passed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.status = 'passed' AND ps.attempts_used = 1) AS passed_first_attempt, round(avg(ps.attempts_used) FILTER (WHERE ps.attempts_used > 0), 2) AS avg_attempts_used, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.status = 'attempts_exhausted') AS attempts_exhausted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status IN ('abandoned', 'withdrawn') AND ps.status NOT IN ('passed', 'skipped')) AS abandoned FROM path_steps ps JOIN enrollments e ON e.id = ps.enrollment_id JOIN learning_paths lp ON lp.id = e.learning_path_id WHERE ps.active AND e.active GROUP BY lp.id, ps.topic_id, e.pilot_arm

changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la vista v_llm_cost_summary (solo lectura): por día, curso, proveedor, modelo y tarea, número de llamadas, costo, tokens, latencia, aciertos de caché y salidas inválidas (AD2).
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW v_llm_cost_summary AS SELECT date_trunc('day', l.created_at) AS call_day, j.course_id, l.provider, l.model, l.task, count(*) AS calls, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.from_cache) AS cache_hits, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'invalid_output') AS invalid_outputs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'error') AS errors, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'budget_exceeded') AS budget_exceeded, sum(l.cost_usd) AS cost_usd, sum(l.input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(l.output_tokens) AS output_tokens, round(avg(l.latency_ms)) AS avg_latency_ms FROM llm_call_logs l LEFT JOIN ai_jobs j ON j.id = l.ai_job_id GROUP BY date_trunc('day', l.created_at), j.course_id, l.provider, l.model, l.task

changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la vista v_item_validity (solo lectura): por ítem, votos válidos e inválidos de la anotación ciega y el veredicto de cada evaluador, insumo del kappa de Cohen (AD3).
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW v_item_validity AS SELECT i.id AS assessment_item_id, i.topic_id, i.source, i.item_type, i.review_status, count(a.id) AS annotations, count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.verdict = 'valid') AS valid_votes, count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.verdict = 'invalid') AS invalid_votes, max(a.verdict) FILTER (WHERE a.evaluator_slot = 1) AS slot1_verdict, max(a.verdict) FILTER (WHERE a.evaluator_slot = 2) AS slot2_verdict, (count(a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.evaluator_slot IN (1, 2)) = 2 AND count(DISTINCT a.verdict) = 1) AS evaluators_agree FROM assessment_items i LEFT JOIN item_annotations a ON a.assessment_item_id = i.id AND a.active WHERE i.active GROUP BY i.id
